rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is exceptionally good or of superior quality.

example.english: The desserts at this restaurant are truly exceptional.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲甜品真係好出色。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tim4 ban2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ceot1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when something is unusual, distinctive, or not ordinary, rather than simply very good.

example.english: The design of this gift is exceptional.
example.traditional: 呢份禮物個設計好特別。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan2 lai5 mat6 go3 cit3 gai3 hou2 dak6 bit6
